title: Items with product names
statementMd:
For each order line show the order id, the product name and the quantity.

Expected columns: `order_id`, `name`, `quantity`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT oi.order_id, p.name, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
